name: Bapko Metal Fabricators
old_description: BAPKO Metal Inc. is a self-performing contractor specializing in miscellaneous steel and architectural metal fabrication and installation. Founded in 1978, we have developed strong partnerships with leading General Contractors across California who rely on our experienced team for innovative solutions, client-centric service, and value-added expertise.
about:
BAPKO Metal Inc. is headquartered in Orange, California, and has operated there since its founding in 1978. The company began as a partnership, transitioned to family ownership for 28 years, then to single ownership before becoming 100 % employee‑owned in its 41st year of operation. This ownership structure underpins a family‑centric culture that the firm says drives its growth and financial resilience.

The firm is a self‑performing contractor that fabricates and installs miscellaneous steel and architectural metalwork. Its services span estimating, design‑assist, 3D BIM modeling (using Tekla Structures), laser scanning, project management, and full‑scale production in over 55,000 sq ft of shop and office space across multiple buildings. Two dedicated divisions handle structural steel and high‑end architectural metals such as stainless steel, bronze, aluminum, and glass.

BAPKO works primarily for general contractors throughout California on commercial, healthcare, educational, industrial, hospitality, and sports‑entertainment projects. Notable installations include the Gaylord Pacific Resort & Convention Center in Chula Vista, the Intuit Dome (Clippers Arena) in Inglewood, and the Din Tai Fung restaurant at Downtown Disney in Anaheim.

The company emphasizes its all‑in‑one, self‑perform model as a differentiator, citing proactive project management, rapid turnaround, and the integration of emerging technologies like 3D laser scanning. Employee ownership is presented as a source of financial stability and a commitment to long‑term client relationships.
